simple.meaning: אֶרֶז (ʼerez) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 73 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Judges, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 12 more, beginning at Leviticus 14:4. Its contexts include blood, death, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶרֶז (H730).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֶרֶז (ʼerez) / H730 is traced through Leviticus 14:4, Leviticus 14:6, Leviticus 14:49, Leviticus 14:51 as a generated source-based concept entry.
